content: Abana koneme epe kagaa kone mada narabuaniaalia
Goa pea-ga Juda aanu pirapere ake ora epe ta pae? Go page yogane rugi kepene konere Juda onaa madaa akea pua epe ta pae?
Gore abare Gote-me Juda aanu nipuna epe agaa surubenalo kasa. Goa pea-pulu kone rayo madaa Juda aanumi epe yae misimi.
Gore Juda medalomame kone rulae gimeme pare Gote-me go kone namogea nipuna agaa narasalia.
Dia-ga onaa rayore yaa agaa lala peme pare Gote-me oro yaalo ora agaa ta. Gote-na buk madaa agaa gupa ia:

content.text: Neme agaa te rabu nimuna agaa loraalimi.
Onaanumi koso lape agaa teme rabu neme nimuna agaa rabuanaalia.

content: Goa pea pare niaame wae yae pema rabu onaanumi Gote-na redepo ne kone adola peme yaalore gore ora epe ta pea. Goa pua Gote-me niaa madaa kedaa gialia rabu ora waea pi tema ya? Neme go agaa tore su amaa piri aanuna kone maredepo yainalo to.
Dia, gupa natema. Gote-re nipu redepo ne kone su piruaaya. Goa pea-ga nipumi su amaa piri onaa rayo koso lape agaa mea katea.
Goa pea pare neme yaa agaa lagula pe yaalore onaanumi Gote-na ora agaa ria epe-rupa pagaliminalo lagula pe. Go pula pe yaalore akeane Gote-me ni pupitagi ne aa tea ya?
Goa tea-ga lamina: Niaame wae yae pemare epe yae alo patalo pema. Onaa medalomame neme apo agaa loaayo teme pare makiraeme. Goa teme-ga nimu madaa koso lape agaa tea rabu nimuna wae yoto mealimi.
Onaa rayore redepo ne-rupa napimi
Goa pea-ga niaa Juda aanuri ruru radona mudu pirua epe-rupa pima tema? Dia-ga Juda page su ruru rado page wae yaeme rigitea.
Gote-na agaa pa ti buk madaa agaa gupa ia:

content.text: Su amaa piri onaa rayore redepo ne onaa padane-daa napimi.

content: Goa pua kone makuaae onaa rayo ora padane-daa napimi.

content.text: Onaa meda Gote aasa pulalo napimi.

content: Onaa rayome Gote masaa rilaawa ora pa-rupa piruaeme.

content.text: Onaa rayome ora wae yae pu pimi.
Ora padaneme page epe kogono napea.

content: Nimumi agaa teme rabu matmat-para rogaaemede

content.text: aa rona pugu pi-rupa agaa teme.
Nimumi wae kone sua ora wae makirae agaa teme.
Nimumi wae agaa teme rabu mugununa eke mua teme.

content: Nimuna agaame ne wae rero pi agaare
Nimumi aloma puare onaanu radaa mapaawa
Oro yaalo pora-nia pameme rabu

content.text: nimumi oyae maoyaawa wae kedaa kateme.
Go pua nimumi Gote madaa paalame naomeme.

content: Gore Gote-me onaanu-para nipuna rekena isade pepa kasa-pulu go onaanumi rekena agaa mogealiminalo gisa. Goa pea-ga su amaa piri onaa rayome Gote-na ini agaa madaa pa agaa mada na-abuteme. Dia go rekena agaame onaa rayo Gote-na koso lape agaa pagaliminalo mea gisa.
Gote-na rekena agaa mogealia-pulu go aare Gote-na ini agaa madaa redepo ne aa-rupa napia. Dia, rekena agaana kogonore aa medame pupitagi nalia-daare mea waatea.
Gote-me onaanu maredepo yalia

Pare Gote-me onaanu maredepo yaalia rabu go porare ora rekena agaana kogono-daa dia. Moses-me rekena agaa tisa rabu page Gote-na agaa lakene aanumi agaa lakesimi rabu page nimumi Gote-na maredepo ne kone madaa tisimi.
Onaanumi Yesu madaa kone rulaeme-pulu Gote-me nimu maredepo yaaya.
Onaa rayome pupitagi neme-pulu nimumi Gote-na oro yaalo mapiraape kone na-ademe.
Pare Gote-me epe raba meape kone sua onaanu esepe maredepo yaasa-pulu nimu Yesu Krais raapu epe-rupa mapiraasa. Goa pea-pulu nipumi nimu madaa natalia.

Gote-me Yesu mea rapaasa rabu niaana kone kedaa omenalo gisa. Go rabu niaame Yesu madaa kone rulalima rabu niaana wae yae mea rubalia. Onaanumiri Gote-me Yesu mea gisare onaanu nipu raapu epe-rupa pirinalo pisa. Abadere Gote-me pawa pirua onaanuna wae yaenu pa adaba pirisa.

Pare abia Gote-me onaanu nipu raapu epe-rupa mapiraainalo niminaaeme-pulu Gote-me onaana wae yaenu waru adea. Goa pea-ga Gote-me nipuna epe redepo ne kone mea waatea. Goa pua onaa rayome Yesu madaa kone rulalimiri nipumi go onaanu maredepo yalia.
Goa pea-daa niaa Juda aanu akeane agaa adaapu tema ya? Niaa rekena agaa mogealima rabu niaame agaa adaapu mada tema ya? Dia, pare niaame Gote madaa kone rulaema rabu agaa adaapu mada tema.
Gore gupa pagamina: Onaanumi Gote madaa kone rulalimi-daare Gote-me go onaanu maredepo yalia. Onaanumi rekena agaa mogeaaeme-daare nipumi nimu namaredepo yalia.
Go Gote-re niaa Juda onanuna Gote agu pia? Onaa ruru radonuna Gote page napia? E, nipu ruru radona Gote page pia.
Gote-na kone ora padane ia. Juda aanumi nipu madaa kone rulalimi rabu Gote-me nimu maredepo yalia. Goa page ruru radonumi kone rulalimi rabu Gote-me nimu page maredepo yalia.
Goa pea-ga niaame kone rulalima rabu rekena agaa rasalima ya? Dia, niaame kone rulalima rabu rekena agaa puri waru mapalaalima.
